author: DaiqingChen
body:
* **GO term ID and label for which you request a definition update**
collagen trimer (GO:0005581)

* **The gene products to remove**

- [ ] ADIPOQ, EntrezID: 9370, HGNC:13633, Protein name: Adiponectin
- [ ] EMID1, EntrezID: 129080, HGNC:18036, Protein name: EMI domain-containing protein 1
- [ ] EMILIN1, EntrezID: 11117, HGNC:19880, Protein name: Emilin-1
- [ ] EMILIN2, EntrezID: 84034, HGNC:19881, Protein name:Emilin-2
- [ ] CTHRC1, EntrezID: 115908, HGNC:18831, protein name: Collagen triple helix repeat containing 1
- [ ] GLDN, EntrezID: 342035, HGNC:29514	, Protein name: Gliomedin
- [ ] OTOL1, EntrezID: 131149, HGNC:34071, Protein name: Otolin 1
- [ ] COLQ, EntrezID: 8292, HGNC:2226, Protein name: Collagen like tail subunit of asymmetric acetylcholinesterase.

* **Reference(s)**
PMID: 21421911

> Dr. Sylvie Ricard-Blum states that "The criteria to name a protein collagen are not well defined and other proteins containing one triple-helical domain (Table 2) are not numbered with a Roman numeral so far and do not belong to the collagen family _sensu stricto_. "
The gene products being mentioned in the Table are ADIPOQ, EMID1, EMILIN1, EMILIN2. Although these proteins structured as trimer, they are not defined as collagen, hence should be removed from collagen trimer.

> She also wrote "gliomedin is recognized as a membrane collagen (Maertens et al. 2007)".
To me seems like GLDN is not defined as a classic collagen, but it is still a collagen trimer. @Matrisome 

  PMID: 15618538
  CTHRC1 is more defined as a glycoprotein to regulate collagen deposition, than a collagen. Should be removed from collagen trimer.

* **Additional information**
Fail to find evidence of why we should remove OTOL1 and COLQ from collagen trimer.
title: Term annotation update: remove gene products from collagen trimer (GO:0005581)
